scope: Real isolated PostgreSQL and owned Anvil18559; explicit in-memory fixture signing provider and mocked Privy SDK API shape. No live provider wallet/signature, production qualification, public transaction or human-key proof.

checks.name: explicit local fixture wallets bind stably to players and separate roles without exporting keys
exact request nonce and signed bytes persist before broadcast; retries and owner checks retain the same intent
actual local broadcast and canonical receipt reconciliation replay the original transaction hash
lost provider reply retains its exact unsigned transaction and nonce before signing and broadcasting once
mainnet unapproved recipients value spending and silent local custody fallback are refused
official Privy SDK-shaped fixture pins offline owner and scoped delegate rejects owner runtime keys and broad delegates
policy templates separate bounded player approve/swap from recipient-restricted treasury transfer and reject mainnet
explicit treasury policy expansion preserves wallet address audits pinned versions replays once and refuses unresolved payouts
